title: unified-rollouts: improve canary/A-B/shadow autorollback heuristics and observability
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: stabilize canary/A-B/shadow rollouts by improving autorollback decisioning, adding metric quorum and composite-metric support, and surface richer observability for rollouts. This PR bundles a small refactor of the autorollback engine, new metric-matching logic for multi-metric rollouts, and improved telemetry so SREs and platform engineers can diagnose regressions faster.

Summary of changes (high level):
- Refactor autorollback engine to separate metric evaluation and decision policy.
- Add metric quorum logic: require N/ M metrics to violate thresholds before rollback.
- Add composite-metric support (weighted combination of latency/error/quality).
- Improve weight handling for canary -> A/B staged rollouts to support gradual ramp-down.
- Add shadow traffic probing stage and quarantine window to avoid noisy early signals.
- Emit rollout-level telemetry: rollout_id, active_stage, metric_quorum, composite_score, decision_reason.
- Add end-to-end tests and integration test harness changes.
- Update docs and rollout examples (redwood-docs) with recommended safety guard configs.

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests cover engine refactor and metric quorum permutations.
- Integration tests simulate multi-metric failures and verify correct rollback behavior and alerts.
- E2E tests run in perf-canary lab with synthetic traffic patterns (success, transient spike, long-tail regressions).
- Canary rollout in staging used to validate observability fields and rollout transition times.

Checklist: [x] unit tests added/updated  [x] integration tests added  [x] e2e tests added  [x] docs updated  [x] telemetry verified in staging

Backward compatibility: default behavior remains unchanged unless teams opt-in to quorum or composite metrics in rollout policy. Old configs still work.

Rollout plan: squash-merge to main, monitor staging dashboards for 24h, then rollout to production with canary weight 2% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic safety gates.

Related: Linked Linear tasks ENG-8243 (autorollback refactor), ENG-8321 (obs rollout metrics).

Ethan Brooks (review): can we add a guard to prevent rollback when only a single metric spikes for <30s? suggested adding quarantine window — implemented.
Aisha Kapoor (author): added quarantine window and corresponding integration tests to simulate transient spikes.
Lena Müller (approval): tested in staging with synthetic regressions, telemetry looks good and decision_reason is actionable. Approving.

release_notes: Improve autorollback decisioning: metric quorum, composite metrics, quarantine window for transient spikes, and richer rollout telemetry. Default config unchanged; opt-in features for teams to tighten safety guards.
